source: Own measurement on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 3, 12 episodes, 2 per unit): the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth), mean_episode_credit 1.0, every unit 1.0. The set was selected again on 2026-11-23 after the units changed (a unit's cameras stand off the equipment sheet's nominal poses: lab_sim.OFFSET, rule 4b of tests/review/unit_fit.py, tests/hidden/selection_fit.json): draws 1 and 2 are void, draw 3 tried 13 candidates and kept 12, each at credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json). One full verify of the reference on this set under ale validate (pinned engine vendor/ale bfb7505) from a clean checkout of commit 058b5f70, run validate-5b459699, in the separate verifier's own image (tests/Dockerfile): mean_episode_credit 1.0, 12 of 12 episodes at credit 1.0, no aborts, no simulation faults, the numerics check and the render self-test passed, untouched 0.0, probe pairs 988 of 1168 differing. After the cameras' drawing change of 2026-11-24 (a ring's wall, the shield and the cabinet's walls drawn as one mesh each; amendment 6 of tests/hidden/episode_selection.json) the same verify from a clean checkout of commit afc20604, run validate-e53b3fd8: 12 of 12 episodes at credit 1.0 with the same step counts, the same probe pairs, untouched 0.0. The measurements on the earlier sets (draws 1 and 2, the units before 2026-11-23) are in this file's history.
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json), and again in the full verify named in the source. The reference answers nothing from the clock and the simulation's numerics are pinned and checked, so a verify of the reference repeats in its credits. full_at 0.98 is kept under the run credit of 2026-11-19: two cold tubes missed over the set (0.0056 or 0.0083 of the metric each, with a complete run) still give reward 1.0; a run that does not count costs its whole episode (0.083 of the metric), so the reference reaches reward 1.0 only with all twelve runs complete. The reference's longest wire run of a kept episode at the selection took 15263 of the 20000 steps.
